description: This source file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface, facilitating the configuration and registration of AdoNet grain directory services within an Orleans silo builder.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectorySiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for setting up AdoNet grain directory options in the Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: UseAdoNetGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder to use AdoNet as the default grain directory with specified options.

methods.name: UseAdoNetGrainDirectoryAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Overload that uses an options builder action to configure AdoNet grain directory options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds AdoNet grain directory services to the ISiloBuilder with a specified name and configuration options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory (overload)
methods.description: Adds AdoNet grain directory with options builder configuration.
